samples.summary: CSV import now sends formula-only cell patches; the batch endpoint has no server-side evaluation, so the imported cell's `value` is stored as `''`
samples.evidence: `toCellPatch` (packages/cli/src/util/csv-parse.ts:88) and `buildCellMapFromTable` (line ~131, comment: "only the formula is re-sent, so the server recomputes") now emit `{ formula }` with **no** `value`. The consumer of that shape is the batch endpoint the diff never opens: packages/backend/src/api/v1/cells.controller.ts:170 does `v: cellData.value ?? existing?.v ?? ''`, i.e. a new cell gets `v: ''`, and grep for `calculate|evaluate|recalc` under packages/backend/src returns no matches — nothing server-side computes `v`. Recalculation lives only in the sheets client (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1447 `recalculateAllFormulaCells`), which requires a browser client to open the document. Every previous CLI writer supplied a value alongside the formula (`http-client.setCell` at packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts:347 is called with both from cells.ts:63-69), so this is a new shape for the API. Consequence for out-of-diff consumers: right after `sheets import`, `sheets cells get` / `sheets export` report an empty `value` for every formula cell, so the round-trip equation this diff itself edited in scripts/agent/charters/round-trip.md:15 (`sheets import` then `sheets export --raw` → the same data) does not hold headlessly.

samples.summary: Already-installed CLI builds are hard-broken by the newly required `verifier`/`challenge`; the only updated caller is the in-repo CLI
samples.evidence: `CliExchangeDto.verifier` is now non-optional with `@Matches(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,128}$/)` (packages/backend/src/auth/auth.dto.ts:16) and main.ts:65-72 installs `ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true })`, so a `POST /auth/cli/exchange` body of `{ code }` — exactly what any CLI built before this change sends (see the pre-change body at packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:73 in the old form, and the archived contract at docs/tasks/archive/2026/03/20260315-cli-oauth-login-todo.md:476 "Call POST <server>/auth/cli/exchange with { code }") — is now rejected 400. The same login also dies earlier: packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:179-184 throws `BadRequestException` for any CLI state without a `challenge`, which no pre-change CLI sends. The only caller updated in this change is the in-repo CLI; every published/installed copy is an unupdated consumer of this endpoint and its `login` command fails with the generic "Token exchange failed" (packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:76-81) rather than the explanatory backend message. Deliberate per the code comments, but the break lands on callers outside this repo.

samples.summary: `Object.hasOwn` (ES2022) introduced into packages/frontend, whose tsconfig targets/libs ES2020 and which has no `tsc` lane to catch it
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx:36 uses `Object.hasOwn`. packages/frontend/tsconfig.app.json:4-6 sets `"target": "ES2020"` and `"lib": ["ES2020", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"]`, which do not declare `Object.hasOwn` (ES2022); a grep for `hasOwn` across packages/frontend/src shows this is the first use in the package, so there is no precedent that the lib was intentionally widened. Nothing catches it: the frontend has no `tsc --noEmit` lane, and vitest runs on Node where the method exists. Effect on consumers: the login page throws `Object.hasOwn is not a function` on browsers below Safari 15.4 / Chrome 93, and the file will fail the moment type-checking is added to this package. `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(...)` avoids both.

samples.summary: `forRoutes({ path: 'auth/github' })` may also run the confirmation middleware on `GET /auth/github/callback` (Express prefix semantics)
samples.evidence: packages/backend/src/auth/auth.module.ts:48 binds `CliLoginConfirmMiddleware` to `{ path: 'auth/github', method: RequestMethod.GET }`. The route it must not affect is the OAuth callback declared out of the middleware's view at packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:105 (`@Get('github/callback')`). Depending on how Nest mounts module middleware for a path with a method filter (Express `app.use('/auth/github', …)` is prefix-matching), the middleware can also fire for `/auth/github/callback`; a request to `/auth/github/callback?mode=cli&port=49152` would then be answered with the confirmation HTML (cli-login-confirm.middleware.ts:114-121) instead of reaching the callback handler, and would also set a `wafflebase_cli_confirm` cookie on that path. I could not confirm the mount semantics from the source alone — an integration assertion that `GET /auth/github/callback?mode=cli&port=49152` still reaches the controller would settle it.

verdict.reason: Core chain verified in-repo. csv-parse.ts:90-92 and :126-127 emit `{formula}` with no `value` (comment at :123-125 claims "the server recomputes"); sheets-import.ts:103-118 sends those patches to PATCH .../cells via http-client.ts:356-362; the out-of-diff consumer cells.controller.ts:168-172 stores `v: cellData.value ?? existing?.v ?? ''`, so a new formula cell gets `v: ''`. Nothing server-side computes v: grep for calculate|evaluate|recalc|formula under packages/backend/src yields only field plumbing, backend's only @wafflebase/sheets imports are grid helpers, and updateWorksheetCell/writeWorksheetCell (worksheet-grid.ts:183-209) are pure writes. Recalculation is client-only and mutation-path-only (sheet.ts:1447-1455, called from :1265/:1435/:3343), corroborated by docs/design/design-editor/design-editor-engine.md:2026-2028 ("nothing recalculates on load"). Read-back returns the empty v (cells.controller.ts:62, :96), so the round-trip relation asserted at scripts/agent/charters/round-trip.md:15 fails headlessly. One supporting claim IS wrong — "every previous CLI writer supplied a value alongside the formula" is contradicted by cells.ts:50 and :64-70, where `cells set --formula` already sends formula-only — but that only removes the "new shape" colour, not the defect. No guard anywhere populates v, so no named refutation ground applies; behaviour change to a shape consumed outside the diff is in the blast-radius lane at major.

verdict.reason: Every claim in the finding checks out against the repo. auth.dto.ts:14-18 makes `verifier` non-optional with @IsString + @Matches(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,128}$/); main.ts:65-72 installs a global ValidationPipe with whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted, so a legacy `{ code }` body is rejected 400. Independently, auth.controller.ts:179-184 throws BadRequestException for any consumed CLI state lacking `challenge`, and `challenge` is only ever populated from the login-start query string (github-auth.guard.ts:72-78, parseCliChallenge), which a pre-change CLI does not send — so an old CLI fails in the browser leg before the exchange. cli-auth.store.ts:118-128 unconditionally requires the verifier hash to match, with no legacy/optional path. Grep for `cli/exchange` shows the only updated caller is the in-repo CLI (packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:45-46, 70-74); packages/cli/package.json:2-15 shows @wafflebase/cli v0.6.4 is a publishable, non-private binary package, so installed older copies are real out-of-repo consumers of this endpoint, and they surface the generic message at packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:76-81. No refutation ground applies: the code is present as described, no guard or fallback makes the old shape work, and a changed contract with unmigrated consumers in other packages is explicitly in the blast-radius lane. The break being deliberate/commented affects acceptability, not reality.
